DeleteAccount.metaDescription: Request deletion/deactivation of your Five Cut Pro account. Requests are accepted immediately; the account is deactivated within 7 days.
DeleteAccount.title: Delete account
DeleteAccount.intro: Use this page to request deletion of the Five Cut Pro account linked to your email. Requests are accepted when submitted. The account is deactivated within 7 days. We do not hard-delete every record on day one.
DeleteAccount.point1: Your request is recorded and accepted when you submit a valid email.
DeleteAccount.point2: Within 7 days the account is deactivated (sign-in disabled). Account profile data is then no longer used to operate the service. We may keep limited records longer where needed for security, disputes, or legal and accounting duties.
DeleteAccount.point3: Videos, photos, and audio stored on your phone or tablet are not on our servers. Deleting the account does not delete those local files, exports in your gallery, or files in other apps. Remove them on the device if you want them gone.
DeleteAccount.point4: Email support@fivecutpro.com if this was a mistake or you want to cancel before deactivation.
DeleteAccount.formDesc: Enter the email you used to register / sign in to Five Cut Pro.
DeleteAccount.reasonPlaceholder: Why do you want to delete your account?
DeleteAccount.confirmLabel: I confirm I want to deactivate the Five Cut Pro account for the email above within 7 days. I understand that videos, photos, and audio already stored on my device are not deleted by this request.
DeleteAccount.successBody: Your request has been accepted. The account will be deactivated within 7 days. Files that remain on your device are not deleted by this request.
DeleteAccount.errorGeneric: Could not submit. Please try again or email support@fivecutpro.com.
